reason: Paying on delivery for the first order is good, I'll admit that, but I've never heard of Baghdad Express and nobody I know has used it yet. I don't try a new page until I see someone unbox their order on TikTok or a friend tells me it came. And 21,000 in fees on a 30,000 item eats my whole margin if I'm reselling.
objection: After the first order I have to pay in advance to a name that's new. My cousin lost a deposit to a page that disappeared, and a hypothetical Abu Ali on a receipt doesn't mean much until I see real people getting their stuff.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or another trader I know getting a few orders on time, or TikTok unboxing videos from real Baghdad customers showing the item, the receipt and the final price matching the quote.
